prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Marina, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "Did you hear that the neighborhood council is starting fines next month for bins left out after 8am? Mrs. Gable said she already saw them marking houses on Maple Street to start enforcing it."
text: The neighborhood council is officially launching a massive crackdown next month with heavy fines for any bins left out past 8am. They’re already aggressively marking houses on Maple Street, so expect them to be at your door any second!
